name: Blinded
description: Cannot see, automatically fails sight-dependent ability checks; attacks against it have advantage and its attacks have disadvantage.

name: Charmed
description: Cannot attack the charmer or target it with harmful abilities; charmer has advantage on social checks with it.

name: Deafened
description: Cannot hear and automatically fails hearing-dependent ability checks.

name: Frightened
description: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while source of fear is in sight; cannot willingly move closer to source.

name: Grappled
description: Speed becomes 0; ends if grappler is incapacitated or an effect moves the grappled creature out of reach.

name: Invisible
description: Cannot be seen without magic or special senses; attacks against it have disadvantage and its attacks have advantage, subject to other rules.

name: Paralyzed
description: Incapacitated, cannot move or speak, automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks have advantage; hits from attackers within 5 feet are critical hits.

name: Petrified
description: Transformed into solid inanimate substance; incapacitated, cannot move or speak, unaware of surroundings; resistance to all damage and immunity to poison and disease, with other condition effects.

name: Poisoned
description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Prone
description: Only crawl unless standing up; disadvantage on own attack rolls; attacks within 5 feet have advantage, farther attacks have disadvantage.

name: Restrained
description: Speed 0; attacks against it have advantage, its attacks have disadvantage, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

name: Stunned
description: Incapacitated, cannot move, can speak only falteringly, automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks against it have advantage.

name: Unconscious
description: Incapacitated, cannot move or speak, unaware, drops held items, falls prone; automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks have advantage and hits from within 5 feet are critical.

name: Exhaustion
description: Six levels of exhaustion impose escalating penalties, from disadvantage on ability checks to death at level 6. A long rest with food and drink removes one level.
